newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Suharto not going for medical check - sources.
newsitem.headline: Suharto not going for medical check - sources.

text.p: Sources in the office of Indonesian President Suharto denied rumours in the foreign exchange market on Friday that the president planned to undergo a medical check-up in Germany.
"There is such plan and there's no indication at all the president will have a new medical check-up," one source told Reuters by telephone.

Rumours spread in the foreign exchange market that the 75-year-old Suharto would undergo a fresh medical check-up in Germany. Suharto went to Germany for a medical check-up last year and was declared healthy.

Palace sources said earlier on Friday that Suharto would fulfil his official duties during the day, in which he would meet the secretary-general of China's state council and participants at a high-ranking meeting of armed forces officials at the Merdeka Palace.
